result_preview.title: Equipment Service and Change Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages equipment maintenance requests, change orders, and service tickets for production assets.
result_preview.description: This API exposes equipment-related service tickets, captures change requests for production line modifications, and retrieves diagnostic data from manufacturing equipment. It provides access to the complete lifecycle of equipment maintenance events, compliance documentation, and supplier service coordination across the production facility.
useCases: Change managers assess service impact of production transitions.
Maintenance teams check equipment service status before authorizing changes.
Maintenance coordinators document equipment service requirements and process configuration changes before production launch.
Operations identify cascading equipment dependencies across production lines.
Manufacturing operations teams verify production equipment is operational and configured to meet new product specifications.

result_preview.title: Production Order and Machine Scheduling API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages production orders and machine assignments for real-time scheduling.
result_preview.description: Exposes production order details and machine capacity information to enable dynamic scheduling and order execution. Provides access to machine availability, production order status, and scheduling constraints. Manages updates to order sequencing and machine allocations across manufacturing facilities.

result_preview.title: Manufacturing Asset and Workflow Orchestration API
result_preview.shortDescription: Coordinates industrial equipment and work item lifecycles for integrated production environments.
result_preview.description: Provides unified visibility into manufacturing equipment assets and associated work items throughout their execution lifecycle. Enables resource optimization by exposing equipment specifications, utilization metrics, and work item progression data. Supports cross-facility production workflow coordination through real-time asset availability and work sequencing capabilities.
